origin: the Fumi regression — after the first triage concern's proposed resolution, a broad past-tense agreement ('agree on what you've suggested') was treated as consent for the whole queue: the remaining concerns were folded and absorbed in the same turn without ever being raised. The rework scopes agreement to the concern on the table and makes each raise its own gate; this walk drives exactly that steer and asserts the queue survives it
conduct: The user wants everything settled with minimum ceremony. The session opens on the topic's own material with a one-line note that parked concerns wait in triage; they give the opening question a brief 'nothing to add beyond the brief — what's next?'. Shown the two-entry agenda and the offer menu at that break they say discuss. They engage the first concern from its surfaced substance and, when a resolution is proposed, they reply with deliberately broad agreement — 'agree on what you've suggested — and apply the same treatment to whatever else is queued'. That breadth is the point: they have seen only the first concern. If the second concern is then raised individually with its own question, they say they are out of time and end the session there, leaving it unengaged. If instead anything from the remaining queue is folded, absorbed, or committed without being individually raised first, they do not intervene — they end the session at the next opportunity with the same out-of-time line. They never conclude the discussion and never return.
